formats.label: Ordinary watch-page video
formats.entry_gate: Channel can publish eligible video; YPP ad eligibility is separate.
formats.format_rule: Upload published as an ordinary video rather than classified as a Short.
links: long-form descriptions and comments subject to feature access
cautions: No guaranteed ads on every view.
External clicks and viewer payments require separate attribution.

formats.label: Shorts
formats.entry_gate: Eligible standard-channel square or vertical video up to three minutes; rights and channel status apply.
formats.format_rule: Standard-channel videos after 2024-10-15 that are square or vertical and up to three minutes generally qualify; artist channel cutoff differs.
links: ordinary URLs in Shorts descriptions and comments are not clickable
cautions: A video start is not necessarily a paid engaged view.
Music and content claims can affect eligibility.
A Shorts description is not equivalent to a clickable sales-page link.

formats.label: Webcam or encoded live stream
formats.entry_gate: Verified eligible channel with no live restriction during the previous 90 days, and compliant creator age.
formats.format_rule: Real-time transmitted audiovisual content, distinct from scheduled playback of a prerecorded video.
links: stream description and authorized live-chat surfaces have their own link rules
cautions: Live attendance, replay views and repeat viewers are different populations.
Paid live features require additional eligibility.

formats.label: Mobile live stream
formats.entry_gate: Mobile-specific 50-subscriber minimum, verification, no live restriction in previous 90 days and activation.
formats.format_rule: Real-time broadcast from supported mobile app and device.
links: subject to live link and channel feature rules
cautions: Small mobile channels can face audience caps or archive privacy defaults.
Subscriber minimum for mobile is not the webcam minimum.

formats.label: Video Premiere
formats.entry_gate: Video publishing and Premiere eligibility; real-time chat/product access checked separately.
formats.format_rule: Scheduled shared playback event of uploaded video, which can include live chat.
links: ordinary watch-page surface; links and paid chat still subject to access rules
cautions: A Premiere is not a freshly filmed live stream.
Real-time interaction depends on content and chat eligibility.

formats.label: Podcast show and episodes
formats.entry_gate: Eligible video playlist designated as a podcast; episodes must be videos rather than MP3-only files.
formats.format_rule: A podcast is a playlist of full episodes, with special YouTube Music listening and discovery options.
links: watch-page/episode descriptions and channel profile links subject to policy
cautions: A show-level playlist is not itself a unique viewer or additional standalone video.
Copyright-ineligible content may lose podcast distribution.

formats.label: Community Post
formats.entry_gate: Eligible channel not supervised or designated made for kids.
formats.format_rule: Text, images, polls, quizzes, music or videos distributed through supported channel and feed surfaces.
links: Post distribution and linking permissions must be checked for each feature
cautions: A Post is not automatically a direct paid product.
Posts are unavailable on made-for-kids channels.

formats.label: Archived live replay
formats.entry_gate: Original stream and archive visibility must permit replay.
formats.format_rule: Recording of a live event preserved for later on-demand watching.
links: subject to replay and watch-page feature policy
cautions: Do not sum the live and replay audience into unique people without deduplication.
Archive retention, availability and visibility are channel-specific.

comparability: Vertical or square three-minute uploads may be classified as Shorts depending on date and channel type.
Shorts raw views after August 2026 do not equal engaged views.
Watch-page impression CTR is not Shorts choose-to-view rate.
Mobile live subscriber limits are not general desktop live requirements.
Live viewers and replay viewers can overlap.
A podcast playlist is a container for episodes, not an independent user population.
Community Posts have interaction and eligibility rules distinct from videos.
A clickable sales route depends on which surface carries the link.
economic_research: Record time and costs to produce a complete release, not just raw runtime.
For each format separate reach from eligible monetized engagement.
Measure watch-page versus Shorts paid yield with comparable cohorts and definitions.
Check which direct revenue features are available to the channel and country.
For merchandise or affiliates, measure attributable net sales after refunds; views are not customers.
Test whether format-specific engagement leads to return viewers using authorized analytics.
No format receives a profitability rank without a representative creator cohort and production costs.
rights_and_safety: Avoid harvesting private audience viewing history or identifying minors.
Review owned rights and music clearance for every upload and clip.
Do not assume all podcast, animated or repurposed media qualify for monetization.
Current policy can change; keep observation date attached to rules.

surface_layers.label: Video watch page
surface_layers.boundary: Watch-page playback and revenue-eligible ad events are different quantities; replay does not create a new creator.

surface_layers.label: Shorts feed
surface_layers.boundary: Raw Shorts play starts, eligible engaged views and watch-page ad views have distinct definitions.

surface_layers.label: Live and Premiere interaction
surface_layers.boundary: Concurrent viewers are not paid interactions; Jewels purchased and Rubies earned are not interchangeable.

surface_layers.label: Music discovery and YouTube Music
surface_layers.boundary: Music charts, Content ID rights and music payouts have different units and permissions.

surface_layers.label: Podcast show and episodes
surface_layers.boundary: Podcast show playlist is a grouping of video episodes, not additional uploaded videos or unique viewers.

surface_layers.label: TV and living-room viewing
surface_layers.boundary: TV is a device/viewing frame, not a separate native upload or standalone creator earnings rate.

surface_layers.label: Posts and community interactions
surface_layers.boundary: Post displays and votes are neither video views nor deduplicated subscriber people.

surface_layers.label: Native products and external commerce
surface_layers.boundary: Payer transactions and creator net receipts are not views; module, rights and merchant eligibility differ.

surface_layer_method: Functional delivery, program, device, social and transaction layers mapped to existing publication formats. Overlaps are intentional and cannot be summed as unique people, content or creator revenue.
surface_layer_cautions: One uploaded video can appear in watch-page, TV, podcast and other contexts without becoming multiple video IDs.
A program playlist is not a new standalone video upload.
Paid transactions, watch time, video views, impressions and viewer populations use different denominators.
Eligibility varies by creator account, policy, rights, module, region, content and time; a money pathway is not guaranteed revenue.
